productivity_status: Approximate modelling assumption; exact observations, weights and agricultural adjustment have not been reproduced. Scenarios are screening assumptions, not confidence limits.
productivity_measure: LATAM/OECD non-agricultural GDP per person employed; LAC excluding high-income economies is the proposed regional proxy, not a Colombia estimate. OECD per-hour comparisons are only plausibility checks.
productivity_time_convention: Apply the fixed ratio once to eligible yearly factors for 2024-2055; no additional calendar-year GDP growth or manufacturing multiplier.
solar_boundary_assumption: Transfer six matched US residential/utility ratios by phase and category to I-JEDI Colombia utility anchors. US on-site Direct and I-JEDI expenditure-based Direct are approximate counterparts. Preserve combined construction/manufacturing; no invented split. Residential portfolio is not commercial/industrial rooftop.
capacity_basis_assumption: The dimensionless US ratio is transferred to the I-JEDI anchor capacity basis without an additional DC/AC multiplier; retain source capacity labels and flag this transfer assumption.
exclusions: I-JEDI Colombia and rooftop factors derived from it
Already-LATAM employment factors, including nuclear and large-hydro O&M
Global manufacturing totals and mixed construction/manufacturing totals lacking a supported split
Indirect and induced impacts; nuclear O&M; fuel and transmission factors
Unverified provenance: leave unadjusted and flag for review
